title: Netflix reports second-quarter 2016 earnings
主要内容: Netflix reported second-quarter 2016 earnings, which beat analysts' expectations but fell short of its own guidance. The company added 1.7 million subscribers, below its target of 2.5 million. In the U.S., Netflix gained 160,000 members, while internationally it added 1.52 million. Despite the subscriber growth, the stock dropped as much as 15% in after-hours trading due to the company's subscriber numbers missing its own guidance. CEO Reed Hastings attributed the churn increase to the un-grandfathering of long-term members, which he believes is not due to competition. CFO David Wells stated that the un-grandfathering process is expected to finish in the fourth quarter. For the third quarter, Netflix expects to add 2 million international subscribers. The company posted earnings per share of 9 cents on $2.11 billion in revenue, which exceeded analysts' expectations of 2 cents per share. However, the stock has struggled this year, falling over 13% as concerns about competition and content costs persist.
